name: FM Towns Marty
significance: Pioneered 32-bit x86 home gaming and backward compatibility with a rich computer software library of CD-ROM visual novels and arcade ports.

editorialContent.overview: The world's first dedicated 32-bit home console, based on Fujitsu's popular Japanese FM Towns multimedia PC line.
editorialContent.marketLegacy: Pioneered 32-bit x86 home gaming and backward compatibility with a rich computer software library of CD-ROM visual novels and arcade ports.
